Method of Attack: Uses infrared capabilities of security cameras to exfiltrate data and receive commands by blinking infrared LEDs to transmit binary data
Data exfiltration from air-gapped or Internet-connected networks via security camera infrared LEDs
Malware watches camera video feed to detect infrared LED transmissions and convert them into commands
Exfiltration speed about 20 bit/sec per camera; infiltration speed over 100 bit/sec per camera
Bypasses firewalls and antivirus, leaves minimal log traces
Discoverer: Cyber Security Research Center at the Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, Israel
Impacted Systems: Computers interacting with security surveillance cameras/software
Computers on the same network as security cameras
Attack Vector: Installation on computers interacting with security cameras or on same network
Infrared LED blinking on security cameras to exfiltrate data
Infrared LED transmissions to send commands to malware
